DECOR erstattet av KIND (hva slags pynt) + LEVEL_DEFAULT (anbefalt nivå 1-5) + ART_SPARSE (kunst på nivå 1-2)
SIZES flettet med dagens ST_STYLE_SIZES for de 8 eksisterende ID-ene (bench, bookcase, outdoor_table beholdes)
LEVEL_2 er dagens pyntsetning byte for byte; LEVEL_2/4 og ROOM_DECOR_2/4 er utkast til pynt-proben er vurdert
v3: varianter for living (uten spisebord): OLD/NEW_LIST_LIVING og ROOM_DECOR_LIVING; nøklene for living_dining fikk suffiks; meglerens valg er bare nivå 1, 3 og 5 (Petter 12.43)

felles.OLD_ART: one or two framed abstract or botanical prints
felles.OLD_DECOR: Keep the decor restrained and uncluttered: a few chosen objects on each surface, with space around them.
felles.OLD_LIGHT: No lamps are switched on; free-standing lamps are switched off.
felles.NEW_LIGHT_MED_LAMPE: Only the table lamp on the side table is switched on, with a soft glow inside its shade that lights the shade and the table top below it and nothing else; the exposure and the white balance of the room stay unchanged, and the floor lamp and all other lamps are switched off.

LEVEL.1: Keep the decor minimal: one or two chosen objects in the whole room, with plenty of empty surface.
LEVEL.2: Keep the decor restrained and uncluttered: a few chosen objects on each surface, with space around them.
LEVEL.3: Style it moderately: a few books and objects on the main surfaces, tidy and balanced.
LEVEL.4: Style it generously: books, flowers, plants and objects on most surfaces, but orderly.
LEVEL.5: Style it richly: books, flowers, plants and objects on every surface, but never cluttered, and keep the walkways clear.
